subject: PO batching cadence, spend-cap splits, and line-item corrections
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@accretecloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO numbers and spend split questions

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to finalize onboarding but ran into two operational items we need help with before we can sign the SOW: 1) how will PO numbers be issued if our account will span multiple product teams (we expect 3 SAML apps with separate budgets), and 2) one of our line items in the proposed PO file has the wrong SKU mapping (see attached proposed_po_lines_v3.xlsx).

Quick summary of asks: 
- Can Redwood issue either a single master PO with sub-lines or three separate PO numbers tied to spend caps?
- If you can issue separate POs, can you set per-PO spend caps and an overall account ceiling?
- Please confirm how corrections to line items should be submitted so your finance team doesn't reject the invoice.

I've attached our completed onboarding form and the latest PO lines file. We can do a quick call, but we wanted to capture everything here so there's a paper trail.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Procurement, Accrete Cloud
elena.morris@accretecloud.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: accrete_onboarding_form.pdf (onboarding form), proposed_po_lines_v3.xlsx (proposed invoice lines), vendor_manifest_20250903.csv (vendor banking manifest)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@accretecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO numbers and spend split questions

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and the attachments, much appreciated. High level answers up front: yes, we can do either a master PO with sub-lines or issue three distinct PO numbers; we typically recommend separate POs for different cost centers when customers want independent spend caps and reconciliation. Below I've outlined the recommended approach and next steps so we can move to issuance this week.

Recommended approach (preferred):
- Issue three discrete PO numbers (one per product team / cost center). Each PO will have its own spend cap.
- Set an account-level ceiling in our billing system to prevent accidental aggregate overspend — we'll set this to 110% of your planned total to allow short bursts and then alert.
- We'll attach line-level metadata so your invoice can be matched to the correct PO automatically. Important: make sure the SKU column in the PO spreadsheet matches our "Redwood SKU" field. Monica, finance can provide a mapping doc if you need it.

Required items from your side to proceed:
1) Confirm cost-center names and the exact spend cap per PO (USD).
2) Send a corrected proposed_po_lines_v3.xlsx with the SKU column normalized to our Redwood SKU (or flag rows with the current vendor SKU for mapping).
3) Confirm bank wiring details in the vendor_manifest CSV (we usually ask accounting to validate via DocuSign).

Operational notes and timing:
- If we receive the corrected file today, finance can provision provisional PO numbers within 24 hours.
- Final PO issuance (formal numbers stamped in the ledger) happens after DocuSign acknowledgement of vendor banking info (compliance step).
- Line corrections submitted via an annotated Excel are fastest; our ingestion pipeline accepts a column "redwood_sku_override" to avoid full resubmissions.

I'll loop Jonas from Ops to confirm the issuance SLA and Marissa will cover contract/terms if any change is needed. Monica, can you confirm the preferred spend-cap guardrails and whether we should enforce soft vs hard caps?

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@accretecloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO numbers and spend split questions

Soojin / Monica / Marissa —

Thanks, that sounds good. I've attached an updated spreadsheet where we've flagged the two rows with the wrong SKU mapping (tab "fixes"). We've also called out cost-center names: "Identity-Platform", "Telemetry", and "Integrations". Proposed spend caps: Identity-Platform $120,000, Telemetry $85,000, Integrations $45,000 (total $250k).

I've also redacted the bank account on the CSV and will complete the DocuSign acknowledgement once you send the embedded link.

Two quick questions: 
1) For the "redwood_sku_override" column, can you confirm acceptable values (we want to avoid future mapping mismatches)?
2) If we later need to move an unused line amount from one PO to another before month-end, what's the change window and approvals process?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Elena

Attachments: proposed_po_lines_v3.xlsx (updated, tab "fixes"), vendor_manifest_20250903.csv (redacted)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@accretecloud.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO numbers and spend split questions

Elena —

Appreciate the quick update and the corrected XLSX. A few confirmations from Ops/Finance to close the loop: 

1) redwood_sku_override: allowed values are either a Redwood SKU (e.g., RW-ENC-1001) or the vendor SKU prefixed with "VEN:" (e.g., "VEN:ACR-42"). If you provide the vendor SKU we will map it in ingestion; using the Redwood SKU avoids ambiguity.

2) Change window: we allow a non-substantive reallocation (move up to 20% of unused funds between POs) inside a 7-day change window after PO issuance without a new SOW; anything larger requires procurement & finance sign-off and a simple amendment. To request a reallocation, submit the "PO reallocation request" form (shared Drive link below) and Monica will route approvals.

3) Next steps and timeline: 
- Monica will provision three provisional PO numbers by end of day (these are visible in the billing portal with a "PROV-" prefix).
- Elena: complete DocuSign for vendor bank verification (we will send embed link after Monica provisions the PO stub).
- After DocuSign, we'll convert PROV-POs to formal PO numbers in our ledger (target same-day after verification).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1B-Procurement-PO-Requests (PO reallocation request form).

Monica — please confirm when PROV-POs are created so we can send the DocuSign link. Marissa — nothing contractual here but flag if you want to review the amendment language for the reallocation window.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
